name: root-cause
description: Find the cause of a bug from evidence before fixing it, then fix only the cause with a test that fails first

interface.longDescription: Gives the agent one procedure for fixing a bug. It records the symptom, reproduces it, reads the code the reproduction runs through, and lists up to three hypotheses that an experiment could prove wrong. It tests each hypothesis and tries to refute it before trusting it, then fixes only the cause, starting with a test that fails, and checks that undoing the fix brings the bug back. It ends with a report of the symptom, the cause and its evidence, the fix, and other places the same cause affects. It edits only the project you are working on, and does not commit or push unless you ask.
defaultPrompt: Find why this test fails and fix the cause
